Ашваганда.about: Adaptogen: reduces cortisol, anxiety, improves sleep.
Ашваганда.caution: Withania somnifera is an adaptogen. Meta-analyses show that the reduction in cortisol is significant, but the subjective perception of stress may not improve. Effective for sleep. Safety: good in short-term RCTs (4-12 weeks). Long-term data are limited. Caution: autoimmune diseases, pregnancy (teratogenicity in the preclinic).
Ашваганда.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; MA series - moderate effect on anxiety and sleep.
Ашваганда.how_to_choose: Standardization 5% withanolides (KSM-66, Sensoril); root, not leaves.
mechs: Reduced HPA axis hyperactivation in the evening: sleep-promoting effect of the extract
Better sleep quality, especially with insomnia (≥600 mg/day, ≥8 weeks)
Effect on glucose and lipid metabolism (experimental and early clinical data)
Glucose, HbA1c and lipids in diabetes mellitus
Ашваганда.myths: “Works immediately like a tranquilizer” - the effect is cumulative. “Any extract is the same” - withanolides decide.
Ашваганда.name: Ashwagandha
Ашваганда.onset: Anxiety and sleep - 4-8 weeks; cortisol - 2-4 weeks.
